summary: Iteration 142 - Admin Reset Step feature fully tested. Backend: 19/19 tests passed. All reset functionality working correctly: admin-only access (403 for staff), reset passport/address/hmrc/contract each with correct behavior, unknown kind returns 400, audit trail (reset_log) entries created. Frontend: Reset icons (RotateCcw amber) visible only for admin role next to download icons on passport/address/hmrc cards when documents are uploaded. Clicking reset shows confirm dialog, calls API, toasts success, reloads list, closes drawer.

tests: Admin can reset passport step - returns 200 with ok=true, step=passport
Staff can re-upload passport after admin reset
Admin can reset address step - returns 200 with ok=true, step=address
Staff can re-upload address proof after admin reset
Admin can reset HMRC step - returns 200 with ok=true, step=hmrc
Staff can re-submit HMRC checklist after admin reset
Admin can reset contract step - returns 200 with ok=true, step=contract
Each reset appends entry to reset_log with step, reset_by, reset_at
Admin list endpoint returns reset_log entries correctly
Reset icons (RotateCcw amber) visible on passport card when passport_uploaded=true AND user is admin
Reset icons visible on address card when address_proof_uploaded=true AND user is admin
Reset icons visible on HMRC card when hmrc_submitted=true AND user is admin
Reset icons NOT visible when documents not uploaded (correctly hidden)
Reset icons NOT visible for non-admin roles (isAdmin check in code)

critical_code_review_comments: Reset endpoint correctly uses require_roles('admin') - only admin can reset
Reset passport/address deletes file on disk before unsetting fields
Reset uses $unset for clearing fields and $set for flipping boolean flags
Audit trail uses $push to append to reset_log array
Frontend correctly checks isAdmin (user?.role === 'admin') before showing reset icons
Reset icons only appear when document is uploaded (conditional rendering)
seed_data_creation: Sarah has passport, address, HMRC uploaded after test. Contract=false. Reset_log has 16 entries from testing.

Frontend shows amber RotateCcw icons next to download icons on each card header - only visible for admin role when document is uploaded.
